## Clinical Assessment: IVF Case Review

### 1. Morphological Analysis of the Blastocyst Image

The provided image displays a high-quality blastocyst, consistent with the Gardner score of 4AA.

Crucially, there is evidence of the blastocyst actively hatching/herniating through the zona pellucida, particularly noticeable on the upper left aspect of the embryo. This dynamic process indicates good developmental vigor.
